events.title: Demo updates! (1.1.0)
events.summary: Hi everyone! A big update to the Precious Feather demo is now live. Here's everything that's changed since the last demo release (1.1.0). Steam Deck supportThe demo is now fully playable on Steam Deck:Full controller support, including the menus and on-screen button prompts (more on that below).New 1280×800 resolution option to match the Deck's screen.The interface now scales to fit smaller screens, so menus and the HUD no longer get cut off.Store and Discord links now open in the Steam overlay,

events.title: Creators.gg X Precious Feather
events.summary: Are you are creator or enjoy making videos? Precious Feather has been listed on Creators.gg with 2 campaigns that can earn you cash for anyone to join. Earn by either creating short form video content or a full featured video, or just streaming it on Twitch to your audience.Have some fun and get a little something in return.You can join the program via https://creators.gg/programs/1454Ends on September 9th 2026All the best!Clyde

events.title: Demo is out!
events.summary: I'm excited to announce that after a year or so of development I am ready to release this odd game to the public!The demo takes roughly 30 minutes to an hour to complete. It's a good chunk of gameplay, about half of the story.I would really appreciate it if you could leave a review on the Steam demo page as it would mean so much to me to hear your honest feedback.I'm a father, a husband and working on this game solo outside of my full-time job. Whilst I try my best to give a polished experience
